Thanks @lilitkarapetyan - this looks good.  But, the problem in the issue was with submitting lots of documents.

There is some code at line 168 of factory.tsx that submits bulk documents to the database.  It's that code which was getting slower and slower.
Archive this, we no longer require the functionality

issues.title: Infrastructure - robustly handle server not found
issues.body:
The front-end currently falls over if we are unable to connect to the server.  Aah, the backend will, too.

When this happens, we should fail gracefully, and show a page explaining that Serge cannot see the server.

Aah, actually, we can handle this more gracefully - we can also add a URL parameter for `host` - this would let a dev connect to their local server without doing the `.env` file modification, followed by a rebuild.  Or, for someone to connect to the Heroku hosted instance.
